subject: Observability Handoff + Action Matrix — Acme Health Pilot
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>, Nina Gomez <nina.gomez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood-inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability handoff & kickoff — Acme Health pilot

Hi Samir / Nina,

Great to be kicking off the observability portion of the Acme pilot. Per our call last week, goal for this thread is to capture owners, deliverables, and a near-term schedule so your SREs and ours can start wiring dashboards, traces, and alerting.

Attached is a lightweight action matrix (acme_observability_action_matrix.xlsx) that we'll iterate on. High-level scope we propose:
- Dashboard templates: latency, error rate, token-level cost by route
- Tracing hooks: top-level trace spans + instrumentation for request metadata
- Error taxonomy: labeling for retries vs user errors vs infra failures
- Alert routing: per-service SLO thresholds and on-call routing map
- Runbooks: playbooks for common incidents + escalation contacts

Quick asks from our side to move fast:
1) Confirm owners on your side for dashboards/tracing/runbooks (SRE vs App team)
2) Any restrictions for pulling logs/traces (PII, retention limits)?
3) Preferred cadence for rollouts — weekly syncs or twice-weekly check-ins?

Next step: I propose a 45-min technical kickoff with your SRE + our Observability PM (Marissa) next Tuesday 04/06. If that works, I can send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

—
Lauren Bishop
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com
+1 415-555-0132

Attachments: acme_observability_action_matrix.xlsx (Excel, 24KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood-inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability handoff & kickoff — Acme Health pilot

Thanks Lauren — looping internal owners with a first-pass of responsibilities and questions. Samir, adding this here so we stay in the same thread.

Owner proposals (first pass):
- Dashboards (templates & wireframes): Marissa (obs PM) + Acme SRE (TBD)
- Tracing instrumentation: Rishi (platform eng) + Acme backend lead
- Error taxonomy & runbooks: Monica (CS Ops) + Acme service owners
- Alert routing & escalation: Marissa + Acme on-call lead

Open questions I put in the matrix:
- Log access: do we get direct Splunk/Datadog read-only or do we ingest via secure forwarding?
- Retention: Acme’s compliance requires 18 months for audit logs; will need to confirm what traces qualify.
- Alert thresholds: Do you have existing SLO targets we should map to (p50/p95 latency and error-rate targets)?

Proposed near-term milestones (week-by-week):
Wk1: Kickoff + confirm owners + access checklist
Wk2: Dashboard wireframes & tracing spec (initial)
Wk3: Instrumentation roll (canary) + alert prototypes
Wk4: Runbook drafts + grooming session

I attached a quick dashboard wireframe png to illustrate the minimal set we recommend.

Marissa
Observability PM, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com

Attachments: acme_dashboard-wireframes.png (PNG, 480KB)
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Nina Gomez <nina.gomez@acmehealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability handoff & kickoff — Acme Health pilot

Thanks team. A few constraints from Acme:
- We have strict PHI segmentation; logs that include patient identifiers cannot leave our VPC. Traces that carry metadata linking to patient ids must be redacted at source.
- Retention: we can expose aggregated metrics for 24 months, but raw traces must be purged after 90 days per policy.
- On-call: our SREs rotate weekly, primary contact for trial is nina.gomez@acmehealth.com.

We can do the kickoff on Tue 04/06 at 10:00am PT. Please include any access checklist items in advance so our infra team can pre-provision accounts.

Also, for runbooks we need escalation steps that do not require vendor console access — that is, steps our engineers can run without accessing Redwood's control plane.

Samir
Principal SRE, Acme Health
samir.patel@acmehealth.com
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>, Nina Gomez <nina.gomez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood-inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability handoff & kickoff — Acme Health pilot

Samir / Nina — thanks for the constraints and for confirming the kickoff. Updated plan and next steps below (consolidated action matrix attached and a short runbook draft linked).

Consolidated action matrix (highlights):
- Access: Acme to provision read-only log endpoint + redact patient identifiers at ingestion. Owner: Acme infra (Nina) — Due: 2027-04-08
- Tracing spec: Rishi to publish instrumentation guidelines (span naming, sampling, PII redaction). Owner: Rishi — Due: 2027-04-09
- Dashboard templates: Marissa to deliver wireframes + shared LookML/JSON templates. Owner: Marissa — Due: 2027-04-12
- Alert routing: Marissa + Acme on-call (Nina) to map alert targets & notify channels (PagerDuty/Slack). Owner: Marissa/Nina — Due: 2027-04-14
- Runbook drafts: Monica to draft 3 prioritized runbooks (high CPU, token-exhaustion, partial-service degradation). Owner: Monica — Draft Due: 2027-04-15; Finalize after Wk4 grooming

Runbook constraint note: We'll author runbooks with only the steps your engineers can run (shell commands, curl checks, trace-derived diagnostics) and provide a separate admin escalation-only checklist for Redwood operators if vendor intervention is required.

Call: Technical kickoff scheduled Tue 2027-04-06 10:00am PT — calendar invite sent. Please review the attached action matrix and the runbook stub (redwood_onboarding-runbook.md) before the call; that will make the meeting productive.

If anything else is needed before Tue, ping me directly.

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com
+1 415-555-0132
